description: Capability for the settings window and runtime Box windows. Plugin windows are deliberately excluded: they load pages written by third parties, and WebView treats http://plugin.localhost as a local origin, so granting them the host commands would let plugin code invoke desktop/box/workspace operations directly and bypass the permission gate. Plugin windows get exactly the five host capabilities instead, via the separate `plugin` capability. `allow-host-commands` is the app-level permission defined in src-tauri/permissions/host-commands.toml; without it Tauri would not check app commands at all (see the ACL note in that file). Keep the two command sets disjoint.
